text_block_list.text: (Grrrrrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
—!? U-Um, are you alright?
Could you be hungry, perhaps?
Worried about the rather hungry Wonder Acute was her colleague, Trainer Kiryuin.

Born into a prestigious family in the trainer world, serious to a fault, yet kind at heart.
That is precisely why they simply cannot leave things be.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Besides, she looks terribly worn out...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly. This is my own way of getting ready... for my important debut race~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for making you worry, young lady.

At first glance, she looks unwell, but...
her condition is perfectly fine.

Just like a boxer cutting weight,
before the real deal, you cut food and water to the bare minimum and hone your body. That's—
Wonder Acute's conditioning method. Her personality is warm and gentle, but deep down, she's truly stoic.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, my body is ready,
but my mind is still floating up in the clouds.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can I get the usual?
That "routine" to fire me up.

—A routine.
Yes, Wonder Acute always
asked for this extreme encouragement.
choice_data_list: Alright, here goes: Fighting Spirit Shoulder Massage!
Alright, here goes: Fighting Spirit Shoulder Massage!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yes, whip me into shape, please.
(*Whack! Thwack! Whack!*)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fuho...
(*Whack! Thwack-whack! Thwack!*)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Waho...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: What on earth is this...?
(*Whack! Thwack-whack! SMACK!!*)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hyohhooo, it's heeeere!!
Now I'm completely pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...
Trainer <username>...?
That felt a bit rough, but..."
choice_data_list: Don't worry about us, we're fine with this.
Don't worry about us, this is fine for us.

text_block_list.text:
Getting this fighting-spirit shoulder pat before a race
is exactly what fires Wonder Acute up.
It really does.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fuho, fuha, fhungaaaa!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
She ran off, you know?
Is this... also not a problem?
"...I got a little too worked up, as you'd expect. Maybe because it's my Make Debut."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute-san, calm down!
Just settle down a little more!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho? You're right, I really must calm down~.
But...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fuhoo!!

It takes the two of us to somehow restrain a raging Wonder Acute.
She seems to be the type to get especially fired up at the racetrack. But—

This is a display of her hidden fighting spirit.
Let us look forward to the race.
